title: Fuselage — Aft Lower Shell Joint Land — Eddy Current Inspection Before Doubler Replacement
abstract: A one-time eddy current inspection of the aft lower shell joint land on the highest-cycle aircraft, run before the doubler replacement so that any existing corrosion is quantified while the joint is still closed.

sections.planning_reason: On the earliest aircraft the interim sealing standard was applied after some corrosion had already started, and the corrosion is not visible without disassembly. Replacing the doubler on such an aircraft without knowing the condition of the joint land risks discovering an out-of-limit finding with the aircraft already stripped and the kit already committed. This inspection is run first so that operators can plan the work realistically and Aeralis can size the repair support.
sections.description: A one-time eddy current inspection of the joint land between stations C52 and C66 on both sides, performed through the existing drain grommet positions with a bolt-hole probe, and a detailed visual inspection of the visible flange edge.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Get access to the aft cargo compartment and lift the cargo floor panels between stations C52 and C66. Remove the drain grommets and the washers AGS334024-84 at each of the six positions per side. Do an eddy current inspection of the joint land through each grommet hole to the depth given in the accomplishment instructions, using the reference standard supplied with the tooling set. Do a detailed visual inspection of the doubler D5331120951225 flange edge over its full length. Record every indication with its station and its distance from the nearest fastener. Install new washers and refit the grommets. Install the cargo floor panels. Report the inspection result to Aeralis whether or not a finding was made, because the result sizes the repair support for the doubler replacement bulletin.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to aircraft MSN C00001 through C00239 that are at the interim sealing standard and have not yet been brought to the corrosion-resistant doubler standard. Aircraft already at the doubler standard have had the joint land inspected as part of that embodiment and are not in the effectivity.
sections.material_note: No kit is required. Washers AGS334024-84 are consumed at twelve per aircraft and are available from stock. The eddy current reference standard is loaned by Aeralis on request and must be returned within ninety days.

type_data.compliance_time: Before the embodiment of the doubler replacement bulletin, and in any case at the next scheduled C-check.
